note: Labeled fixture corpus for the publish scan. Positives are sanitized: every credential-shaped value here is synthetic and matches only its own shape. Credential literals are stored SPLIT into thirds in `tokens` and referenced as %%tN%% markers, so the committed bytes carry no contiguous token shape for a secret scanner to trip on.

# Paying for an HTTP resource with x402

The 402 response carries a payment-required header. A client signs an EIP-3009
authorization and retries. Settlement lands on Base in about two seconds.

Costs are quoted in atomic USDC, so 10000 means one cent. Nothing here is
confidential computing, and the endpoint is a public one.
